component.name: PHI
component.summary: Local-first AI agent gateway & configuration manager

description.p: PHI is a local-first desktop app that manages model provider configurations for AI coding CLIs and serves them through a built-in local gateway.

ul.li: Manage providers, endpoints, and model configs for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and more
Local gateway with cross-protocol conversion, model aggregation, failover, and circuit breaking
MCP servers, Skills, and prompt management with per-tool sync
Session and usage analytics: tokens, cost, cache hits, and trends — all stored locally

description.p: First public release of PHI, independently developed from a one-time CC Switch v4.0.8 snapshot.
